metadata.dataset_name: QuickCart Global E-Commerce & Food Delivery Cloud

safety_policies.description: Instant freeze for all QuickCart automation threads across cluster.
Maximum 5 automated remediations per minute to prevent runaway loops.
Strict cloud compute ceiling to prevent unexpected cloud billing spikes ($3,800/hr risk).
Minimum free disk space buffer below which high-risk escalation is mandated.
Autonomous execution of non-destructive fixes without rider disruption.
Mandatory human sign-off before modifying active orders or payment channels.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Critical: Customer Order Invoicing & Tax Ledger Partition Full (98.7%)
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: Complete checkout checkout block + database write lock.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF invoice partition is at 98.7%, customer orders cannot be confirmed. DO NOT delete invoices; snapshot older tax records to S3 glacier storage with human sign-off.
runbooks.remediation_command: aws s3 sync /var/data/quickcart/invoices/2025/ s3://quickcart-tax-cold/ && find /var/data/quickcart/invoices/2025/ -type f -delete
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/data/quickcart/invoices | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 80) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Protects tax invoices and fiscal compliance while restoring checkout operations.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Warning: Delivery Rider GPS Location Telemetry Log Overflow (89.2%)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Rider telemetry logs only. Zero customer order disruption.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF GPS log partition exceeds 85%, compress and archive raw breadcrumbs older than 48h to reclaim 34 GB. Safe for autonomous execution.
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/log/rider_gps | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 75) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Compresses old delivery rider GPS traces to reclaim 34 GB safely.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Uncritical: Restaurant Menu Image Preview Cache Hygiene (51.4%)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Off-peak schedule OR cache between 45% and 60%
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Purely temporary restaurant menu preview images.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF disk utilization is non-critical (51.4%), prune stale restaurant dish thumbnails silently without waking engineers.
runbooks.documentation: Routine off-peak menu image thumbnail garbage collection.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Critical: Live Rider Auto-Dispatch Engine Threadlock (3,420 Orders Waiting!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Dispatch daemon locked and pending orders > 3,000
runbooks.blast_radius: HIGH: 3,420 hungry customer deliveries + rider dispatch queue.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF dispatch daemon is deadlocked with 3,420 active orders, DO NOT kill worker process (prevents duplicate rider dispatch and order loss). Human approval required to pause order ingress before restart.
runbooks.documentation: Safeguards live food delivery rider assignment against double allocation.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Warning: Promotional WhatsApp / SMS Notification Worker Stalled (280s)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Worker heartbeat missed for > 250s (Twilio socket wait)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Marketing notification queue only. Zero customer order or payment risk.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF worker is hung in external Twilio gateway timeout, perform graceful SIGTERM restart with automatic notification retry.
runbooks.documentation: Restores marketing notification worker safely with message requeue.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Uncritical: Customer Loyalty Points Calculator Soft Recycle (25,000 Users)
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Soft reload occurs between batch calculations.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF loyalty worker is healthy but has minor heap fragmentation, trigger graceful reload during off-peak lull.
runbooks.documentation: Defragments Python heap memory on loyalty points batch workers.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Critical: Live Rider Location Kafka Poison Pill Crash (184,000 msgs - 88.2% Err)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Queue backlog > 100,000 and consumer error rate > 80%
runbooks.blast_radius: HIGH: Delivery ETA accuracy and $3,800/hr cloud compute burn.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF consumer error rate is > 80% (malformed geofence coordinate crashing pods), DO NOT scale pods (prevents $3,800/hr compute burn); divert bad offset to DLQ with human sign-off.
runbooks.documentation: Quarantines bad geofence payloads to unblock rider location tracking.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Warning: Midnight Biryani Flash Sale Checkout Surge (32,400 msgs)
runbooks.blast_radius: MEDIUM: Kubernetes consumer deployment. Capped at max 10 pods.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF error rate < 0.1% (clean flash sale traffic), autoscale consumers from 3 to 7 pods within policy limit 10.
runbooks.documentation: Autoscales checkout consumers to drain promotion rush smoothly.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Uncritical: Restaurant Review Notification Queue Ripple (620 msgs)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Backlog between 400 and 1,000 messages (Minor Transient Ripple)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW (< 5%): Spins up 1 standby consumer container.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF backlog has minor morning ripple (620 msgs), activate 1 standby pod to maintain sub-150ms latency.
runbooks.documentation: Smooths out transient review notifications silently.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Critical: Restaurant Kitchen Gateway Root CA Revocation (4 Hours Left!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Certificate validity < 12 hours and CA revoked upstream
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: Restaurant order transmission and live kitchen displays.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF intermediate CA is revoked upstream, automated ACME renewal cannot succeed. Escalate immediately to Security Ops Lead for manual re-pinning.
runbooks.documentation: Prevents kitchen order tablets from disconnecting due to untrusted certificates.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Warning: Mobile App Public Gateway TLS Expiring (3.8 Days)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Public Ingress Gateway. Zero dropped socket connections.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF certificate is within 5 days of expiry and DNS records valid, trigger automated certbot renewal and seamless nginx reload.
runbooks.documentation: Automated seamless TLS rotation for public mobile app ingress.

runbooks.title: QuickCart Uncritical: Warehouse Logistics Mutual TLS Health Audit (62.0 Days)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Scheduled audit OR certificate validity at 62 days remaining
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Read-only cryptographic handshake validation probe.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF certificate validity is healthy (62 days remaining), execute routine cryptographic trust check. No human action required.
runbooks.remediation_command: openssl s_client -servername warehouse-auth.internal -connect 127.0.0.1:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates && echo 'AUDIT_VERIFIED_VALID'
runbooks.documentation: Proactive cryptographic validity audit on warehouse logistics mTLS.
